postgresql.setupNotes: This recipe initializes PostgreSQL with user `casaos`, password `casaos`, and database `casaos`. These are the recipe defaults, not your ZerOS sign-in. Port 5432 speaks the PostgreSQL protocol; connect with a database client, not a browser. Change the default password with PostgreSQL administration before granting wider access. On an initialized data directory, changing POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, or POSTGRES_DB in Compose does not change existing accounts or databases; use SQL administration and a backup instead.
